name: Nora3D
tagline: AI CAD for functional parts you can keep editing
description: Nora3D is AI CAD for functional parts. Describe what the part needs to do or its dimensions, then keep refining the same model with plain-language prompts or regular CAD tools. You can import STEP files, inspect each change, and export STEP or STL. It runs in the browser on desktop, tablet, and phone.
